title: Defusing Explosive Prompts: Understanding and Preventing Trigger-Based Prompt Injections in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.22510v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As LLM applications integrate with external tools, they are increasingly exposed to indirect prompt injection (IPI), where adversarial instructions are embedded in retrieved content. Conventional IPIs fire on contact: the moment an agent ingests the content, it carries out the instruction. We introduce the explosive prompt, a conditional payload that stays dormant until an attacker-chosen trigger is met, in effect a training-free, inference-time backdoor planted in a single piece of retrieved content.   This temporal separation reaches where ordinary IPI cannot. On frontier models that refuse the bare imperative almost entirely, rephrasing the same goal as a dormant conditional drives real, state-changing tool execution against a live agent backend (a paired mean of 16.5% vs. 2.4% for the imperative, reaching 34.2% on a proprietary model). translated_title: 拆除爆炸性提示：理解并防御LLM智能体中基于触发的提示注入
translated_abstract: 随着LLM应用与外部工具的集成，它们越来越多地暴露于间接提示注入（IPI）的风险之下，即对抗性指令被嵌入到检索到的内容中。传统的IPI在接触时即触发：智能体一旦摄取内容，就会立即执行该指令。我们提出了“爆炸性提示”（explosive prompt），这是一种条件载荷，在攻击者选定的触发条件满足之前保持休眠，实际上相当于在单条检索内容中植入的免训练、推理时后门。这种时间上的分离能够到达普通IPI无法企及之处。在前沿模型几乎完全拒绝直接命令式指令的情况下，将同一目标改写为休眠的条件式指令，可以驱动真实的、改变状态的工具执行，攻击实际运行的智能体后端（配对平均成功率为16.5%，而命令式指令仅为2.4%，在某个专有模型上达到34.2%）。在九个生产级智能体（OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini CLI、Anthropic Claude Code CLI等）上的试验中……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“爆炸性提示”这一新型间接提示注入攻击——一种在攻击者设定的触发条件满足前保持休眠的条件载荷（相当于免训练的推理时后门），证明其能绕过前沿模型对直接命令式指令的拒绝，显著提升对真实生产级LLM智能体的攻击成功率，并研究相应的防御方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "explosive prompts," a novel indirect prompt injection where a conditional payload stays dormant until an attacker-chosen trigger is met—effectively a training-free, inference-time backdoor—showing that this temporal separation bypasses frontier models' near-total refusal of direct imperatives and substantially increases real-world attack success rates against production LLM agents.
